menu.needs_extended: Dice Shaker needs the mod Dice Rush Extended. Please install Dice Rush Extended first.
slots.title: DICE SHAKER
slots.subtitle: Choose a save card for Dice Shaker
hud.hint: Click the glass ball to shake the dice!
hud.hint_hold: Tip: hold the mouse button to keep shaking.
gum.title: GUMBALL MACHINE
gum.tooltip: Insert money and turn the crank: every gumball holds talent points. The colour shows how many.
gum.odds: White 1 · Green 2 · Blue 3 · Yellow 5 · Pink 8 · Red 13
combo.help: Combos: pair x{p2} · triple x{p3} · four x{p4} · five x{p5} · six+ x{p6} · straight x{st} · all the same x{as}
talents.title: TALENT TREE
talents.new_die: A new common die joins the ball.
talents.points: You have {v} talent points. Get more at the gumball machine.
lucky.title: LUCKY CUBE
lucky.hint: Click a die to lock it. Locked dice stay, all others are rolled into new dice. Levels are kept.
lucky.tier_hint: Higher tiers cost more but give rarer dice.
tarot.title: TAROT
tarot.hint: Buy the same card again to raise it up to Legendary.
shop.title: SHOP
shop.cosmetic: Only a new look. No effect.
shop.owned_bonus: Every gauntlet you own: +{v}% money. The equipped one gives its effect.
shop.black_locked: Learn the talent 'Black Market Contact' to get in.
shop.black_intro: Illegal cards. Strong, stackable, limited. Nobody saw anything.
book.title: DICE BOOK
book.hint: Roll new dice in the Lucky Cube to discover them.
pause.title: MENU
pause.stats: Shakes: {a}  ·  Earned in total: {b}$  ·  Play time: {c}
gauntlets.none: Buy gauntlets in the shop. Each one gives a bonus.
gauntlets.hint: Click a gauntlet to equip it.
event.shop_sale.name: SHOP SALE -50%
event.shop_sale.desc: {v} s: shop and black market 50% cheaper!
event.talent_sale.name: TALENT SALE -50%

event.tarot_sale.name: TAROT SALE -50%

event.turbo.name: TURBO SHAKE
event.turbo.desc: {v} s: auto-shake 1 s faster, the dice land faster!
fx.none: A solid classic: pays its face.
fx.gamble: {chance}% chance to pay x{mult}, otherwise nothing.
fx.pair: +{pct}% for every other die with the same face.
fx.d20: Rolls 1 to 20. A natural 20 pays x{mult}.
fx.streak: +{step}% for every shake in a row (max +{max}%).
fx.jackpot: {chance}% chance: the whole shake pays x{mult}.
fx.per_die: +{pct}% for every die in the glass ball.
fx.echo: {chance}% chance to pay the whole shake again.
fx.market: Its value changes every 30 s: x{min} to x{max}.
fx.bomb: A 6 pays x{mult}, a 1 pays nothing.
fx.meteor: {chance}% chance: all dice roll their highest face.
fx.swallow: Swallows the weakest die's payout and pays it x{mult}.
fx.seven: If all faces add up to a multiple of 7, the whole shake pays x{mult}.
fx.teacher: Gives the lowest-level die +{xp} XP every shake.
fx.copy: Adds {pct}% of the best other die.
fx.wild: Joker: counts as any face for combos.
fx.pi: Rolls the digits of pi in order and pays x{mult}.
fx.per_rarity: +{pct}% for every different rarity in the ball.
stat.echo_chance: {v}% chance to pay a shake twice
stat.min_face: Every die rolls at least a {v}
stat.treasure_n: Every 25th shake: a treasure worth {v} shakes
stat.coin_chance: {v}% chance per shake for a coin bag worth 20 shakes
stat.lucky_odds: Lucky Cube: +{v}% chance for Epic and Legendary
stat.catchup_x: The lowest-level die gets x{v} XP
stat.black_market: Unlocks the black market in the shop
stat.compact: Dice shrink so up to 12 fit into the ball
